subject: history_social
passage: Before the middle of the 1400s, books in Europe were copied by hand, a slow process that could take a scribe months to finish a single volume. Johannes Gutenberg's printing press, which used movable metal type, changed this. A print shop could turn out many copies of a book in the time a scribe needed to make one, and as a result books became far more ______.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?

explanation.why: The text contrasts hand copying, which took months per book, with a press that could make "many copies" in the same time. "As a result" signals that the blank names the effect of faster production: more books. "Plentiful" fits.
explanation.A: Incorrect. The text is about speed and the number of copies, not decoration. Faster printing explains why there were more books, not why they were more decorated.
explanation.B: Incorrect. The text says nothing about how sturdy printed books were; it is about how quickly they could be made.
explanation.C: Correct. When a shop can make "many copies" in the time it once took to make one, there are many more books available. Books became plentiful.
explanation.D: Incorrect. Hand copying made books rare. The press produced "many copies" quickly, so books became less rare, not more.
